status: Fixed, installed locally and verified on 21312V0 over USB. No push or release.
cause: Viewer skipped independent IMU START for 21312 profile capture but dispatched its samples to the inactive ImuStream, which consumed samples without invoking the display/recording callback.
implementation: All supported models use ImuSampleObserver and one common callback for parsing, timestamp/rate checks, live display and recording. One VIDEO_START/VIDEO_STOP owns camera+IMU; redundant legacy 413 IMU_START confirmation removed. LiDAR-start error rollback also stops the actual aggregate owner.
protocol_evidence: Agent src/control/stream_controller.c at v1.2.0, v1.3.0 and current source: VIDEO_START enables camera+IMU; IMU_START requires already-active aggregate acquisition and only confirms count/rate; VIDEO_STOP stops both. imu_requested_sensors only supplies status reply.

tests.notes: Actual SDK inactive-stream negative reproduces swallowed callback; common sample observer checks 1000 samples/model with both IMU sensor IDs, malformed/non-IMU frames. Capture options, IMU UI/rates/timestamps/units, batch export and offline IMU recorder pass. No device control in regression.
